The '''Voidstream''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by [[Orlean]] during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TORweb" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Orlean Voidstream was first added as part of the [[August]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.5.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="TORweb" /> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> Players can obtain the Voidstream mount through [[Wikipedia:Twitch (service)|Twitch]] Drops, a feature that allows viewers to earn in-game rewards by watching streams.<ref name="Twitch">{{WebCite|url=https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/mission-based-drops?language=en_US|text=How to Earn Drops|archivedate=20240905214754|suppress=1}}</ref>
